subject_session: Buddy, Achilles, Cicero, Gatsby (4 rats; prototype session = Buddy)

headline_stat.name: % of pooled CA1 units significantly theta-entrained (Rayleigh p<0.05)

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 hippocampal CA1 from freely moving rats is the canonical dataset for theta phase entrainment, across four subjects.
justification.handling: Real NWB streamed via remfile, running epochs derived from position speed, cell-type labels used, and units with <30 running spikes explicitly excluded.
justification.analysis: Correct circular statistics (Rayleigh, MRL, circular mean) with an independent STA confirmation, but no phase-shuffle/surrogate control to account for spike non-independence that makes Rayleigh anticonservative at very large n.
justification.correctness: Pooled 345 units, 86.7% significant, median MRL exc=0.124 vs inh=0.207 and MW p=4.2e-12 all reproduce from the committed CSV, are internally consistent with the figures, and are physically possible.
justification.figures: Channel selection, raster, polar histograms, population summary, STA, and cross-session panels are readable, unit-labeled, and show the effect with examples honestly described as the most strongly locked.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and examples are labeled as top cases rather than typical, but the write-up states no limitations (single-session caveats, the n-inflated Rayleigh significance) so it sits at proportionate-but-not-self-critical.
